agent: converter convert.py (Sonnet 5.5), from the saved snapshot

extractions.tool: flattening of runs.json: one row per completed run of the groups the registry holds as setups; score = int(score.earned)/int(score.total) joined with '/'; harness = harnessSlug + ' ' + harnessVersion; case = slug version variant engine; other fields verbatim

rows-means.json: one row per (setup, model) group of runs that the earlier legacy rows averaged (n>1 runs): the arithmetic mean of the runs' per-run score percent (6 decimals), tokens (1 decimal) and cost.comparable (6 decimals); computed by convert.py (statistics.fmean); first_start and last_end are the earliest startedAt and the latest finishedAt of the runs (the hull the mean's runs cover); the site publishes no mean

model.note: subject.modelId: the id the harness was given (openrouter/<vendor>/<model> for opencode, the maker's id for claude and codex)
